messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies, Music Fills The Air

An overcast but mild Friday offers a full moon and a rich evening of music. The local civic thread is the University of Michigan's new soundwave cancer treatment research; science has a new finding on autonomous satellite navigation.
Today will be overcast with a high near 69°F and a low around 45°F, with a 1% chance of precipitation.
The sun rises today at 7:25 AM and sets at 7:26 PM, under a full moon that is 97.6% illuminated.
Evening Music and Arts Across the Area

In Ann Arbor, catch pianist Barron Ryan blending classical and cool jazz at Kerrytown Concert House at 6:30 PM. For a free community gathering, the Ann Arbor District Library hosts Dolly Day with crafts and concert videos starting at 5:30 PM.
The next full moon is tomorrow, September 26.
University of Michigan Advances Cancer Treatment Research

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves. The technique, already FDA-approved for liver tumors, uses targeted soundwaves to break apart tumors.
Saturday Offers Diverse Local and Cultural Events
Tomorrow, consider the "Community Bio Blitz" at Eliza Howell Park in Detroit at 10 AM for a plant ID walk, or the "BIG READ KICKOFF" in Ypsilanti at 11 AM, featuring performances and local history.
Satellites Navigate Autonomously Without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review, moving into final launch preparations.
The schedule for the next Starship launch is unset, with estimates listing no earlier than September 18, 2026.
The evening is full of possibilities; choose one that resonates.
